verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a compliance SaaS platform, but nothing in the evidence shows the core Drata platform can be self-hosted. The buildable GitHub repo is only the endpoint drata-agent, which reports device settings to Drata, and the on-premise integrations connect local tools to the hosted service rather than running Drata itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
